title: fencepost configuration
description: Schema for fencepost config files (.claude/fencepost.yaml, .claude/fencepost/config/*.yaml) and bundled presets.

meta.description: Preset metadata used to render the docs catalog. Ignored at evaluation time; only bundled presets need it.

description.description: One-paragraph summary shown in the preset catalog.

import.description: Bundled preset names to merge in as a base layer, in order. Your own config is applied on top. Names are bare identifiers, never paths. The special name 'all' expands to every bundled preset; 'user' pulls in your user-level (~/.claude) config as a base layer.

default.description: Fallthrough decision when no rule matches. Defaults to ask.

onError.description: Posture when fencepost runs but cannot reach a decision (e.g. an unparseable Bash command). Defaults to ask; headless/CI setups may prefer allow. A broken config always fails closed (deny) regardless of this setting.

tools.description: Rules over tool calls. Non-Bash tools match by name glob; Bash commands go through the bash pipeline.

deny.description: Tool-name globs to deny, each with an explanation shown to the model.

ask.description: Tool-name globs that require user approval.

allow.description: Tool-name globs to allow without prompting. Listing Bash here has no effect; Bash is always evaluated by the bash pipeline.

guidance.description: SessionStart guidance injected into Claude's context. Block-level last-wins on merge.

extra.description: Additional guidance lines appended after the defaults.

redirect.description: Tool-input redirection. Block-level last-wins on merge. Off by default; the claude preset turns it on.

tmp.description: Rewrite bare/prefixed /tmp paths in tool inputs to tmpTarget.

secrets.description: Secrets scanning: deny inputs that contain credentials, redact secrets from tool outputs. Merged field-by-field; allowlists concatenate. Off by default; the secrets preset turns it on.

scanner.description: Which scanner to use. auto probes PATH in preference order; a name pins one scanner.

scanInputs.description: PreToolUse: deny tool inputs that contain secrets.

scanOutputs.description: PostToolUse: redact secrets from tool output before it reaches the model.

allow.description: Exemptions from scanning. Lists concatenate across config layers.

paths.description: Path globs whose file inputs are exempt (e.g. .env.example).

maxScanBytes.description: Content larger than this is not scanned at all.

timeoutMs.description: Hang ceiling per scanner invocation, in milliseconds.

decision.description: What fencepost tells Claude Code: allow (proceed), deny (block with an explanation), or ask (prompt the user).

description.description: Why this tool is denied; shown to the model.

alternative.description: What to do instead; shown to the model.

bashConfig.description: Rules over Bash commands, evaluated on the parsed (tree-sitter) command.

normalise.description: Strip noise (e.g. -n <ns>) from commands with a given prefix before matching.

prefix.description: Command prefix this rule applies to, e.g. kubectl.

strip.description: Regex patterns removed from the command before rule matching.

deny.description: Command prefixes to deny, e.g. "git push --force".

checks.description: Regex smart-deny rules matched against the whole normalised command.

test.description: Regex tested against the normalised command.

description.description: Why the command is denied; shown to the model.

alternative.description: What to do instead; shown to the model.

allowChecks.description: Regex smart-allow rules matched against the whole normalised command (unlike the prefix allow list). Evaluated above ask/allow.

ask.description: Command prefixes that require user approval.

allow.description: Command prefixes to allow without prompting.

discourageChaining.description: Deny &&/;/|| chains that would need approval, with guidance to run the parts separately. Pipes are exempt.

offerManualRun.description: On deny, also offer the verbatim command for the user to run via ! <command>.

arguments.description: Structured rules over a command's arguments (reason about every arg, not a prefix).

interpreters.description: Rules over inline interpreter code (python -c, node -e, heredocs), keyed by language.

redirectRule.description: Fires on a redirection target. Provide exactly one of outside/glob.

mode.description: Which redirections the rule applies to.

outside.description: Fires if the target is outside ALL of these roots.

glob.description: Fires if the target matches this path glob.

description.description: Shown to the model when the rule fires.

alternative.description: What to do instead; shown to the model.

argumentRule.description: Fires on a command's arguments. Provide exactly one predicate.

command.description: Command-name glob this rule applies to, e.g. "rm|rmdir|mkdir".

anyArgOutside.description: Fires if any path-like argument is outside all of these roots.

allArgsInside.description: Fires if there is at least one path-like argument and all are under some root.

anyArgMatches.description: Fires if any raw argument matches this regex.

allArgsMatch.description: Fires if every raw argument matches this regex.

description.description: Shown to the model when the rule fires.

alternative.description: What to do instead; shown to the model.

names.description: Bash command names that invoke this interpreter, e.g. [python, python3].

calls.description: Rules over calls in the inline code.

imports.description: Rules over imports in the inline code.

match.description: Qualified callee glob, e.g. shutil.rmtree or subprocess.*.

argMatches.description: Optional: fires only if any call argument text matches this regex.

pathArgsOutside.description: Optional: fires only if a string path argument is outside all of these roots.

description.description: Shown to the model when the rule fires.

alternative.description: What to do instead; shown to the model.

match.description: Module-name glob, e.g. ctypes or socket*.

description.description: Shown to the model when the rule fires.

sshConfig.description: Host allowlisting for the ssh wrapper. Unset by default: any destination proceeds to ask/allow based on the remote command's own rules.

allow.description: Destination globs allowed to connect to, e.g. "ops@10.0.40.*". If non-empty, any other destination requires approval.

deny.description: Destination globs denied outright, checked before allow.

writeRule.description: Sugar for "a file is opened for writing" outside the given roots.

outside.description: Fires when the written path is outside all of these roots.

description.description: Shown to the model when the rule fires.

alternative.description: What to do instead; shown to the model.
